Whistleblower Alleges USPS Mail Voting System Rushed and Flawed

A whistleblower has claimed that the U.S. Postal Service (USPS) is rapidly implementing an online system to comply with an executive order concerning mail-in voting. The whistleblower alleges that the system is untested and that USPS defied a court order to push it forward. These actions, according to the whistleblower, could potentially 'derail' midterm elections if allowed to proceed. The work to comply with the executive order is described as rushed and sloppy.
